subject: 30-min intro scheduling & roles — priority grid and SME requests
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@stellarhealth.com>, Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + next step: 30-min intro and who to invite

Thanks for your time this morning — great convo. Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we can lock a short product intro that surfaces the parts of Redwood that map to your goals. I attached a 1-page discovery summary and a simple priority grid to help align stakeholders.

What we heard (short):
- Primary use case: embed Redwood for low-latency, multi-tenant inference across dozens of clinical apps (real-time chart-side suggestions).
- Key constraints: SOC2 + HIPAA readiness, per-tenant isolation, predictable 99th %-tile latency under 180ms, and cost targets for high call volume.
- Stakeholders: CTO (Ellen) — platform & compliance; Ravi — data/infra; Priya — product/clinical workflows.

Suggested next step: 30-minute intro walkthrough (brief product demo + how we address latency/security). We can surface Dedicated vs Hosted patterns and a high-level rollout path. If you want a heavier infra conversation, we can make slot #2 a 45-minute deep dive with our infra SME.

Please pick one of these 3 time brackets (we can narrow to exact times after you pick a band):
- Option A: Tue/Wed next week mornings PST (Nov 17–18, 9–11am PT) — good for exec-friendly windows
- Option B: Wed/Thu next week late-afternoon PT (Nov 18–19, 3–5pm PT) — good for engineering attendees on east coast
- Option C: Fri morning Nov 20 (9–11am PT) — compressed calendar day for ops folks

When you reply please: 1) confirm preferred band (A/B/C) and 2) list the names/titles we should include (we'll invite Jordan + Marissa + Connor from our side).

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (short), priority-grid.csv.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

— Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | Calendly: https://calendly.com/jordan-blake/30m

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@stellarhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ravi.sharma@stellarhealth.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@stellarhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T12:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next step: 30-min intro and who to invite

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap and the one-pager is great. Quick answers below: 

We'd prefer Option B (Wed/Thu late-afternoon PT). Specific availability from our side: 
- Wed Nov 18 between 3:30–4:30pm PT (Ellen and Ravi available)
- If needed, Thu Nov 19 between 4–5pm PT (Priya can make it but may need to drop at 4:30)

Attendees we want on the call:
- Ellen Park — CTO (decision owner)
- Ravi Sharma — Head of Data & Infra (technical reviewer)
- Priya Reddy — Product Lead (workflow owner)

Two asks up front: 
1) Please include a short slide or plan showing how data isolation is achieved (our security team will want a quick overview).
2) Can you bring an infra SME who can speak to quantized model latency tradeoffs? If not, we can schedule a follow-up deep dive.

Also, we'll need to start the vendor intake for SOC2 evidence soon — is there a checklist you can share?

Appreciate it — Ellen
Ellen Park
CTO, Stellar Health
ellen.park@stellarhealth.com | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks Ellen — perfect, Option B it is. Below are three concrete slots that match your band; pick whichever works and we'll send a calendar invite. 

Concrete time options (all PT):
1) Wed Nov 18, 15:30–16:00 PT — 30-min intro (Jordan + Marissa)
2) Wed Nov 18, 16:00–16:45 PT — 45-min session (include Connor, infra SME) — choose this if you want the deeper latency/quantization conversation
3) Thu Nov 19, 16:00–16:30 PT — 30-min intro (shorter for Priya's schedule)

We will include a one-slide "data isolation" sketch and a 2–3 bullet SOC2 intake checklist in the invite. Attendees from our side: Jordan Blake (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer), Connor O'Brien (Infra SME).

Other notes: attaching a draft mutual-action-plan (m-a-p-draft.docx) that lists typical milestones and inputs for a pilot. No need to review before the call, but it can help frame next steps.

If you confirm slot #2 we will block 45 minutes and route Connor to cover quantization/latency tradeoffs and GPU topology. Otherwise we'll keep it to 30 and focus on product fit and rollout options.

— Jordan
